topda.notes: Repository static files not live coverage. Historical report counts generated output at different snapshot; do not compare directly to tracked HTML. Site homepage web cache 4 months old; live sitemap inaccessible. No changes to TOPDA.

sources.fact: Scaled content created primarily to manipulate ranking rather than help users is spam.
Search Console returns clicks/impressions/position and may omit rows.
2025 2500 SaaS companies: among sample low ASP self-serve associated with faster growth, not causal estimate or our CAC.
Founder interview: Helploom reports Reddit threads via high-intent searches most useful after SEO/ads; no numeric CAC or revenue verification. No unsolicited promotion recommended.
Marketplace founder story on nights/weekends financial reporting SaaS, no verified unit economics in search excerpt.

scenarios.notes: assume fixed 4h and no further hours or costs; illustrative RPM not AdSense actual.
Assumes no development or CAC beyond fixed 4h/100k; full price and rate assumptions, not market estimates.
Qualified leads distinct from pageviews or visits, conversion to fulfilled paid jobs. Fixed costs and time same; no acquisition time per lost lead included, optimistic.

measurement.period: last 90 complete days, previous 90 days separately
exports: Search Console performance: page, query, clicks, impressions, CTR, average position; separate totals, anonymized/omitted rows acknowledged
GA4 landing page / session source-medium, sessions, engaged sessions, calc_complete and calculator_run separately, outbound_click; no raw user ids or sensitive params
AdSense aggregate earnings / pageviews if active; payment status and cost aggregate
measurement.rule: Do not sum overlapping event counts into unique users. Measure visits, conversion, cash receipts and owner labor separately. No unobserved monetization forecast. No employer data or financial product affiliate.

For OC-022/030 use existing field gates; no additional outreach. Partner acquisition requires consent, transparent affiliation and approved scope.
